description: O11: the REFUSAL of the delete of a static entity record with real consumers. The inherited default of Contact.StatusId and the filter of Contact_CountActive cite Entities.Status.Active, linked by key to the IRecord; without force the delete has to be refused AND the message has to name the two consumers by path. The clean path (repoint with replace and only then delete, brokenConsumers 0) is in tests/jobs/static-record-refactor.json. Measured with the base job:spec-data.

ops._why: count 2, real 2, none derived: the IExpression of the filter and the IExpression of the DefaultValue - the same two paths that the refusal will name.

refused with "op #1 (delete ): InvalidOperationException: delete: refused, IRecord 'Active' is used by 2 consumer(s): IServerAction:Contact_CountActive/IAggregateNode:GetActive/DataTable/ICombineSourcesOperation:Contacts/IFilter/IExpression; IServerEntity:Contact/IEntityAttribute:StatusId/IExpression (list them with usages, fix or remove those usages, or pass \"force\": true to break them)". THE ORDER of the two paths in the message changes from run to run (measured: in one run the filter first, in another the StatusId first), so the expectError asks for each path separately and never both together.
